title: TCL 65Q550G (TCL BeyondTV4, codename UNKNOWN), Google TV 11, firmware V8-R51MT08-LF1V095.021344
header:
TCL 65Q550G (TCL BeyondTV4, codename UNKNOWN), Google TV 11, firmware V8-R51MT08-LF1V095.021344

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-65q550g/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-65q550g/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Known quirk on this firmware: default_input_method points at com.baidu.input, which is not
installed, so no keyboard appears in search fields. Set Gboard as the IME (see README gotchas).
Tested on one unit over Ethernet: setupwraith owned saved Wi-Fi networks and claimed HOME;
disabling it over Ethernet allowed CleanYourTV to become HOME. Do not disable it over Wi-Fi.
